concerns.text: Tasks T040 and T045 mandate 'Salience-Based' sample selection using gradient magnitude. This contradicts FR-002 and the Edge Cases in spec.md which define the dream phase input generation solely via 'random token masking' and 'entropy checks'. Introducing gradient-based selection is a silent relaxation of the spec's defined mechanism (random sampling) and a scope expansion not authorized by the plan or spec.

Tasks T041 ('Logical Depth Metric') and T043 ('Metabolic Cost Proxy') introduce new metrics (reconstruction error reduction, FLOPs*time) that are not defined in spec.md Success Criteria (SC-001 to SC-005) or Functional Requirements. This violates the 'Single Source of Truth' principle by adding unverified acceptance criteria to the implementation.

Task T044 requires a '1-shot, 5-shot, 10-shot' evaluation protocol. Spec.md SC-002 and US-2 define the success criterion as a paired t-test across '5 random seeds' on a 'held-out few-shot task' (singular). This task introduces a multi-shot variable not present in the spec, effectively weakening the defined experimental protocol.

Tasks T015 and T017 implement a 'Denoising Autoencoder (DAE) on masked real data' and explicitly note this diverges from spec.md FR-002's 'generative replay' language. While the plan mentions a 'Critical Revision', the tasks do not include a verification step to confirm the spec amendment (T057) is complete before implementation, risking a constraint violation where the code implements a different mechanism than the ratified spec.

Task T036a schedules 5 seeds per temperature value (4 values = 20 total runs). Spec.md SC-002 requires a t-test across '5 random seeds' for the primary comparison. The task conflates the sensitivity sweep with the statistical power requirement, potentially violating the 'paired t-test' constraint if the analysis logic (T025b) does not correctly isolate the temperature variable or if the total run count exceeds the time budget (SC-004).
